name: Default
shortDescription: Browser-based 2D and 3D CAD built in Rust and WebAssembly: command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks, layouts, DXF and DWG open and save, and PDF, SVG and PNG export.

alerts.message: Drawings are not stored on the server: the web app runs in the browser and keeps only preferences and panel layout there. Save or export your drawings to your own device before closing the tab.
The upstream project publishes no container image; this one is built by a community maintainer from the source of the official release tags.
